hero.headline: Backend-leaning full-stack engineer with hands-on industry experience
hero.subtitle: Built and maintained applications with JavaScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and SQL. Strong fundamentals in Data Structures and Java. Seeking a Junior Software Engineer role in backend or full-stack development.

aboutText: Hi - I am Aman Kumar. I can build elegant and efficient web experiences with strong engineering. I hold a B.E in Information Science and enjoy working across frontend, backend, and automation projects. I like to blend a corporate polish with subtle futuristic touches.
